summary: Attribute sub-fields: description and support (full/none/partial/N/A) required, details required for partial, membership only for action_group, platforms only for platform, version_added; notes for extra info but not check_mode or diff.
questions: What values can an attribute's support field have?
When must I fill in details for an attribute?
Where should I document check mode support, notes or attributes?

answer_card.title: Attribute fields and notes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `description` (required), `support` (required: `full`, `none`, `partial`, `N/A`).
- `details`: required when `support: partial`.
- `membership`: only for `action_group`; `platforms`: only for `platform`.
- `version_added`: if support was extended later.

`notes`: other important info, but **not** check_mode/diff (use `attributes`) or general links (use `seealso`).
